items.description: Main tasks entry point — orchestrates base profile (chrony, rsyslog, utils, motd) then Redis cluster setup; replaces role::redis_cluster ordering logic
items.notes: Orchestrates base.yml then cache_redis.yml, with validate_credentials.yml first.

items.description: Base OS profile tasks: install chrony + chronyd service, install rsyslog + rsyslog service, conditionally gated on manage_ntp and manage_syslog variables
items.notes: Loads OS vars, applies base_utils, installs chrony and rsyslog conditionally.

items.description: Base utilities tasks: install OS-family-specific utility packages (vim/vim-enhanced, wget, curl, jq, dnsutils/bind-utils) and render /etc/motd from motd.j2 template; conditionally gated on manage_utils and manage_motd
items.notes: Deploys MOTD template and installs utility packages. OS vars loaded by base.yml before this is called.

items.description: Redis cluster main tasks: inline redis_role fact logic (stat replica.conf), health-check via ansible.builtin.uri, write health_check.json, myapp artifact deployment (stat version.txt, get_url, unarchive, copy version), Enterprise Scheduler registration (blocked — see mySecretType1 conversion note), mySecretFunction1 (NOT SAFELY CONVERTIBLE — developer review required)
items.notes: Fixed: moved include_tasks: install.yml to the top of the file so the redis OS user/group exists before health-check directory and file tasks reference owner:redis/group:redis.

items.description: Redis install tasks: install redis package, configure redis (bind 0.0.0.0, port 6379, requirepass from vault secret, maxmemory 2048mb, allkeys-lru, AOF appendonly/everysec), ensure /var/log/redis directory (owner redis, group redis, mode 0755), start+enable redis service
items.notes: Fixed: added explicit 'Ensure Redis configuration directory exists' task (ansible.builtin.file, state: directory, /etc/redis) between the log dir task and the template task. The redis package does not guarantee /etc/redis/ creation on all distros.

items.description: Redis cache profile wrapper tasks — sets environment_name fact and includes profile_redis_cluster tasks
Molecule scenario configuration — delegated driver, local connection (not docker/podman)
Molecule converge playbook — runs the role via a single ansible.builtin.include_role task
items.notes: Includes role via ansible.builtin.include_role with stub credential vars (redis_password, redis_service_token) required by validate_credentials.yml.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /etc/motd, /var/lib/redis/health_check.json, /var/log/redis (dir, owner redis, mode 0755), /opt/myapp/version.txt (contains 2.1.0), redis service running, chronyd running, rsyslog running
items.notes: Split into 3 plays: (1) filesystem state — /etc/motd, /var/log/redis, /var/lib/redis/health_check.json, /etc/redis/redis.conf, /opt/myapp/version.txt; (2) services — chronyd, rsyslog, redis; (3) Redis port 6379 and redis.conf content assertions.
